title: Ping-Pong Request-Response Protocol
description: Two-block CCITT SDL-88 request-response protocol with bidirectional channel, signal routes, retransmission timer, and responder echo process.

title: Alternating-Bit Reliable Data Link Protocol
description: Reliable stop-and-wait Alternating-Bit Protocol (ABP) in SDL-88 featuring 1-bit sequence numbering, timeout retransmission, and duplicate frame filtering via DECISION.

title: Vending Machine Coin and Dispense FSM
description: SDL-88 state machine for an automated beverage dispenser tracking accumulated coin credit, item selection validation, change refund, and dispense timeout recovery.

title: Telecom Call Setup and Teardown Signaling
description: ISDN/Q.931-inspired telecom call-control signaling between originating and terminating switch exchanges using SETUP, ALERT, CONNECT, and RELEASE handshakes with ring-timeout supervision.

title: Multi-Block Industrial Safety PLC Interlock Architecture
description: Three-block IEC 61508 industrial process safety interlock architecture in SDL-88 coordinating pressure/temperature sensor monitoring, safety PLC voting logic, and emergency shutdown valve actuation.
